This residence is located at 2688 Vine, Vancouver, British Columbia and is situated in the district of Kitsilano in Vancouver. Other neighbourhoods nearby are Fairview Vw, Arbutus and Point Grey. While has no properties currently available, the district of Kitsilano has 173 postings available. That's just 3.93% of the 4,403 total listings for sale in the city of Vancouver. Homes in Kitsilano are listed for an average asking price of $2,042,695, or an approximate monthly mortgage of $7,455.* That is 45% higher than the average asking price of $1,408,060 found across all Vancouver homes for sale. Homes listed in Kitsilano are an average of 1,549 sq ft, with 3 beds and 2 baths. Apartments make up less than one quarter of properties for sale in the community around 2688 Vine.

* Monthly payments are an estimate based on a mortgage with 20% down @ 2.65% with a 5-yr Variable rate

As well, there are 391 condos in Vancouver. The list price of $3,900 is 0.01% lower than the average list price of $2,041,474 for Kitsilano real estate and 99.72% lower than the average list price of $1,408,060 for Vancouver real estate.
